resourceProfile.assessment: The complete English and Korean source scope, review metadata, glossary, and project concept references were available locally.

automatedQuality.summary: Translation review checks, typecheck, complete build, route and generated-link checks, and the full test suite passed after the cycle was finalized.

linguisticCritique.summary: A bounded Korean pass identified thirteen remaining trigonometry, circuit, and unit-translation defects; all thirteen were corrected.

competentHumanReview.summary: No competent Korean human review was performed in this cycle; changed IDs remain machine-drafted.

publicationAuthorization.summary: No merge, publication, deployment, or residual-risk authorization was requested or granted for this cycle.

findings.summary: The Korean right-triangle formulas retained English side labels.
evidence: The formulas used opposite, adjacent, and hypotenuse instead of 대변, 인접변, and 빗변.
findings.resolution: Localized all three side labels in the formulas.

findings.summary: The inverse-trigonometry formulas retained English side labels.
evidence: The previous expressions contained opposite, adjacent, and hypotenuse.
findings.resolution: Localized the side labels while preserving inverse-function notation.

findings.summary: The worked-example setup omitted the standard space between the numerical value and cm.
findings.resolution: Changed it to 10 cm 길이의 빗변.

findings.summary: The worked-example formulas used inconsistent or overly literal Korean side labels and omitted unit spacing.
evidence: The previous formulas used 반대쪽 and 인접 and displayed 5cm and 8.66cm.
findings.resolution: Changed the labels to 대변 and 인접변 and normalized SI spacing.

findings.summary: The series-cell formula retained the English word series in a Korean annotation.
The inch conversion retained the English unit name.
evidence: The previous formula began 1 inch in a Korean section.

findings.summary: The foot conversion retained English unit names.
evidence: The previous formula used foot and inches in English.
findings.resolution: Changed the unit names to 피트 and 인치.

findings.summary: The yard conversion retained English unit names.
evidence: The previous formula used yard and feet in English.
findings.resolution: Changed the unit names to 야드 and 피트.

findings.summary: The right-triangle section mixed Korean prose with English formula terminology.
evidence: The paragraph defined Korean side terms while the displayed formulas retained English labels.
findings.resolution: Aligned all displayed ratios with the Korean explanation.

findings.summary: The angle-finding section was inconsistent across its formulas and worked example.
evidence: Inverse formulas and example labels did not use the terminology established in the Korean prose.
findings.resolution: Applied one consistent Korean terminology set throughout the section.

findings.summary: The imperial-length subsection mixed Korean and English unit naming.
evidence: The inch, foot, and yard formulas were all still in English.
findings.resolution: Normalized the three length conversions to Korean unit names.

findings.summary: The worked example mixed Korean prose with inconsistent side terminology and unit spacing.
evidence: Its setup, labels, and displayed units followed different conventions.
findings.resolution: Normalized the setup and both example formulas.

findings.summary: The Korean circuit section retained an English series annotation after surrounding labels had been localized.
evidence: The formula annotation was the only remaining English direction label in the cells subsection.
